title: Data Analyst (Databricks)
description:
Role Summary

The Data Analyst is responsible for transforming data intoactionable insights that support business decision-making. The role requiresstrong business context understanding, stakeholder engagement, analyticalthinking, and data visualisation expertise to communicate insights effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Insights

  • Develop a deep understanding of business processes, operational challenges, and policy objectives.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into analytical requirements.
  • Analyse datasets to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and performance indicators.
  • Provide recommendations and insights that support data-driven decision-making.

Analytics & Data Visualisation

  • Build, enhance, and maintain dashboards for performance reporting, operational monitoring, and user behaviour analytics.
  • Design intuitive and impactful visualisations that effectively communicate complex findings to business users.
  • Apply data storytelling techniques to present insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Define and track business metrics

Data Preparation & Analysis

  • Query, clean, and analyse data using SQL, Python, and Databricks.
  • Validate and interpret data to ensure analytical outputs are accurate and meaningful.
  • Collaborate with data engineers to improve data accessibility and usability for reporting purposes.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Develop user guides and business documentation for dashboards, reports, and analytical products.
  • Maintain documentation on reporting methodologies, metric definitions, and analytical standards.
  • Support agile delivery activities such as requirements gathering, user story creation, and acceptance testing.
  • Explore automation opportunities to improve reporting and analytics workflows.

Competencies & Requirements

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in SQL and Python for data analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with dashboard and visualisation tools (e.g. Databricks, Power BI).
  • Experience using Databricks or similar analytics platforms.
  • Ability to create compelling visualisations and data stories for diverse audiences.
  • Strong documentation and report-writing capabilities.

Preferred Skills

  • Understanding of business intelligence and KPI frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Jira, QA testing, and agile delivery practices.
